critique.evidence: The headline and supporting sentence clearly argue for operating metrics over accuracy, and “Compare configurations” supplies a next action. However, the precision–recall chart is not self-explanatory: its x-axis repeats “100%” before ending at “65%,” undermining trust and readability. The cards also do not consistently state the threshold/configuration behind each result. On mobile, explanatory and chart text is extremely small, the ablation table becomes dense cards, and the CTA appears only after a long scroll. The global mobile/tablet header hides Metrics beyond the visible navigation rail, so location is unclear without swiping.
critique.fix: Correct and simplify the PR-axis labeling; show the active model, dataset, threshold, and false-positive constraint beside every derived metric; add a concise above-the-fold takeaway connecting the numbers to a decision; enlarge mobile labels; and surface a persistent or earlier “Compare configurations” CTA. Ensure the header visibly indicates “09 Metrics” at every viewport.
